name: Sparrow
overview: Scripture uses the sparrow to illustrate God's attentive care and sovereign provision for even the smallest creatures, emphasizing the believer's greater value in His sight. The sparrow, though sold cheaply—two for a farthing or five for two farthings—is not forgotten by God, and not one falls without His knowledge. Their nests and homes near God's altars symbolize His protection and presence. These truths encourage believers to trust in God's faithful care and to live without fear, knowing they are precious to their heavenly Father.
